name: Keyboard Layout
author: lef
description: Display and manage Hyprland keyboard layouts: up to four layouts with variants, synced switching across every keyboard, more switch keys, optional top-center toast, and safe edits of ~/.config/hypr/input.lua with rotating backups and restore.

barWidget.description: Active keyboard layout indicator: click for settings, right-click or scroll to switch, middle-click for the main layout.
